column3: Retains tearing off and the ears.
Retains tearing off and the ears.
Retains Aaron’s repeated name and saying.
Retains the connected statements rather than an exclamation about how quickly.
Retains seed and their active possessing the land.
Retains said rather than explicitly threatened.
Retains hand in the singular and the repeated writing.
Retains strength and weakness and does not name Moses.
Retains causing them to drink without explicitly saying forced.
Retains they gave it to me as a separate action.
Retains the gate and sons of Levi.
Retains the thigh and the repeated each.
Retains fell without explicitly adding dead.
Retains an instruction to fill their hand, not a declaration of completed ordination or blessing.
